Re: RDD/DDF Support for HBase under the hood

Yeah the goal in SparkR is to use the data sources API [1] in Spark to bridge to other storage systems like HBase. So as a part of our DataFrame API we already have methods [2] that can take in a data source specification.

However I am not very sure about the status of the HBase data source implementation and we haven't tested this with HBase AFAIK.

[1] https://databricks.com/blog/2015/01/09/spark-sql-data-sources-api-unified-data-access-for-the-spark-platform.html
[2] https://github.com/amplab-extras/SparkR-pkg/blob/05b9126c31c9a69fde12314d56695346f12d954b/pkg/R/SQLContext.R#L274
